messages.subject: R plugin in transmart
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I want to integrate my R script in transmart so that I can use it for advanced analysis.

As a first step, I modified one of the existing R scripts in transmart and tried to add new advanced analysis for the same.

I am following the instructions given at (https://wiki.transmartfoundation.org/display/TSMTGPL/Steps+to+add+new+advanced+analysis).

I am not sure what value should be put in 'params' field of 'searchapp.plugin_module'

I can see the new analysis in the GUI but its not functional i.e I cannot drap and drop values in the text box given for the particular analysis.

Can some one point me to the proper documentation.

regards,

Anita
